Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

About UPS & Our Culture

Friday evening through Sunday night — that is when the UPS weekend operation runs at its highest volume, and it is when our Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers earn some of the strongest hourly rates in our entire package center network. If your Monday-through-Friday schedule is locked and you are hunting for weekend warehouse jobs that actually pay well, offer union benefits, and leave every weekday untouched, UPS weekend shifts were designed specifically for you. We are one of the only employers in the logistics industry offering weekend warehouse jobs near me with full Teamsters union representation, meaning your weekend hours come with the same contractual protections and pay guarantees as any full-time role.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I have a full-time desk job Monday through Friday and I work UPS weekends to pay down my mortgage faster. The weekend differential on top of the union wage makes the hourly rate genuinely excellent, and I get my full weekdays completely untouched. In two years I have built a serious financial cushion on this schedule. If you are looking for legitimate weekend warehouse jobs near me that respect your weekday life, UPS is it." - Current Weekend Package Handler, Indianapolis, IN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handler, you work Friday evening through Sunday sort shifts inside our package center, processing the weekend's elevated residential delivery and pickup volume that builds throughout the week and peaks on Saturday and Sunday sort windows.

  • Weekend Volume Processing: Sort, load, and unload the high-density package volume that accumulates through the week, operating at peak throughput across Friday night, Saturday, and Sunday shifts to clear the facility for Monday morning delivery routes.
  • Weekend Surge Handling: Navigate the additional volume generated by weekend e-commerce orders and residential pickups, adapting quickly to higher-than-weekday sort targets that UPS weekend shifts routinely reach.
  • Trailer Loading & Unloading: Pull inbound packages from arriving trailers and build outbound loads in package cars and linehaul lanes, using UPS-approved stacking methods to maintain load quality standards across all weekend shifts.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Weekend Warehouse Package Handlers receive a weekend shift differential on top of the Teamsters base union wage. Full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal time, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance apply regardless of your part-time weekend schedule. Weekly paychecks are direct-deposited every Friday. Your entire Monday-through-Friday schedule remains completely untouched.

jobs.description:
Looking for a consistent day-shift schedule with an industry leader in information management? Join our team as a Warehouse Associate / Record Center Specialist in Chicago, where you will enjoy steady hours, competitive weekly pay, and a direct path to permanent employment. If you thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment and enjoy staying active on the job, this is the ideal opportunity to build your logistics career.


Schedule: Mon – Fri, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (No Weekends)

﻿Pay Rate: $18.26/hr.

Duration: 4-months contract (potential temp-to-hire)


What You’ll Do


  • Process and track orders by locating, scanning, and logging storage boxes, binders, files, and backup tapes using handheld RF scanners and proprietary tracking systems.
  • Manually lift, move, and arrange inventory boxes and totes weighing from 24 lbs up to 100+ lbs across concrete surfaces and changing elevations.
  • Operate material handling equipment including hand carts, pallet jacks, and trucks to safely transport materials throughout the facility.
  • Prepare and stage shipments by building, loading, and shrink-wrapping pallets at ground level and loading trucks for outbound delivery.


What We’re Looking For


  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, and pull storage boxes weighing up to 100 lbs. without assistance on a regular, prolonged basis.
  • Comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and climbing ladders or stairs throughout a 9-hour shift.
  • Must possess ASTM F2413-11 compliant protective safety-toe footwear with a slip-resistant rating of "Better" or "Best."
  • Strong basic literacy in English to read labels and process system tracking, basic computer skills, and a safety-first mindset.


Work Environment: You will work in an active, physical warehouse setting. The environment involves working on concrete floors, using material handling aids, climbing secure ladders, and navigating varying floor elevations safely.


Employment Note: This is a temporary/contract engagement focused on immediate operational support; standard corporate health benefits and paid time off are not provided during the initial contract duration.
